title: Witch and Sorceress
description: A dark fantasy scene shows a standing witch in a pointed hat and flowing black robes holding a staff with a blue orb, standing behind a blue couch where a pale woman in a black off-shoulder dress sits. The background features an arched window looking out onto a snowy, icy landscape at sunset with a large red moon and floating orbs.
prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy illustration of a tall witch wearing a pointed hat and tattered black robes standing behind a blue vintage couch, holding a tall ornate staff with a glowing blue orb. A pale sorceress in a black off-shoulder gown sits on the couch looking to the side. An arched window reveals a frozen snowy landscape under a giant red blood moon and smaller red orbs. Roots and tentacles spread across the floor with scattered spellbooks, candles, and gold coins. Mysterious glowing orbs float in the air, eerie and atmospheric mood.
